rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something strangely odd or unsettling.

example.english: Their smile was so uncanny that it gave me chills.
example.traditional: 佢個笑容古怪到我有啲心寒。
example.jyutping: keoi5 go3 siu3 jung4 gu2 gwaai3 dou3 ngo5 jau5 di1 sam1 hon4

rows.note: Use this for something inexplicable or seemingly supernatural, especially when it feels ominous.

example.english: I keep running into the same stranger lately; it’s really uncanny.
example.traditional: 呢排成日撞到同一個陌生人，真係邪門。
example.jyutping: ni1 paai4 seng4 jat6 zong6 dou3 tung4 jat1 go3 mak6 saang1 jan4 zan1 hai6 ce4 mun4

rows.note: Use this mainly for a place or atmosphere that feels eerily gloomy or ghostly.

example.english: This corridor feels so uncanny at night that it gives me chills.
example.traditional: 呢條走廊夜晚陰森森，行過都覺得背脊發涼。
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 zau2 long4 je6 maan5 jam1 sam1 sam1 haang4 gwo3 dou1 gok3 dak1 bui3 zek3 faat3 loeng4
